submission.implementation_notes: Compiled with Plinth 1.65.0.0 and the `datatypes=BuiltinCasing` plugin flag. Builtin casing has been a mainnet feature since the van Rossem hard fork (protocol version 11, 2026-07-18); plutus-tx-plugin 1.67 dropped the flag and enables casing under the default `SumsOfProducts`. This build additionally emits the batch-6 `dropList` builtin (van Rossem protocol version) for cursor gaps of three or more fields in the typed decoder, replacing the chained `tailList` induction with a single call whose term size does not grow with the gap; the emission was gated behind the same build flag, so the non-casing sibling for this line stays byte-identical. Source: `lib/HTLC.hs` (+ `lib/Plinth/Decoder.hs`, `lib/Plinth/Decoder/Named.hs`) in plinth-cape-submissions @ 6b75b5a3fe1cf56b195cc4222cf939a2812cee78.
